ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Discovery Activity Via Dnscmd.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects an attempt to leverage dnscmd.exe to enumerate the DNS zones of a domain. DNS zones used to host the DNS records for a particular domain.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\dnscmd\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/enumrecords.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/enumzones.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/ZonePrint.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/info.*")))
